symptoms: Return of Spontaneous Circulation (ROSC) following cardiac arrest.

management_steps.details: A - Airway: Open and maintain, intubate if required, use capnography. B - Breathing: Ventilate every 6 seconds (10 bpm), target SpO2 92-98%, target normocarbia (PaCO2 35-45 mmHg), protective lung ventilation (Tidal Vol 6 ml/kg IBW, PEEP >= 5 cmH2O, target pH > 7.20).
C - Circulation: Target SBP > 90 mmHg (MAP > 65 mmHg). Monitor urine output and lactate. Inotrope: Start Adrenaline at 0.05 ug/kg/min and titrate to effect.

D - Differential: Search for H's and T's. E - Evaluation: 12 lead ECG (incl right-sided), coronary angiography if cardiac origin. F - Freezing (TTM): Target normothermia aggressively (Avoid temp > 36.5°C for >24 hours). G - Glucose: Maintain blood glucose at 8-10 mmol/l. H - Head/Neuro: Treat seizures, delay prognostication for at least 72 hours post normothermia.

warnings: Delay neuro-prognostication for at least 72 hours post normothermia.
